description: This Java class ResponseBuffer manages input character buffers, accumulating strings and parsing complete response lines terminated by CRLF or LF characters, then passing each full line to a ResponseListener for processing.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer
classes.description: A class that buffers input characters, detects complete response lines, and dispatches them to a listener.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer.ResponseListener
classes.description: An interface for handling complete response lines extracted by ResponseBuffer.

methods.name: ResponseBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ResponseBuffer with a ResponseListener.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends new string data to the buffer and processes it to extract full response lines, invoking the listener for each.

methods.name: hasCRLF
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains a CR or LF character signaling line termination.
